stress.scope: One reference car, production SuspensionRig at 120 Hz and SceneView on the reference circuit at fixed 1920×1080 balanced rendering; conservative reference controller capped at 16 m/s. Audio graph receives intentional synthetic simultaneous four-wheel full slip, 12000 RPM/full load and impact 0.5, independent of the actual physics telemetry. Captured real telemetry is separately derived for adapter cost/finite checks.

pairedFrames.scope: Initial sequential 8-second audio-off then 8-second audio-on periods on the same driving/rendering workload; includes graph activation; no statistical claim of isolation from GPU/OS variation.

analyser.scope: 2048 mono-downmixed PCM values observed per render frame. Windows can overlap; sampledValues is not a count of unique audio samples. This is not a hardware-underrun detector.

limitations: Digital sample peaks are not acoustic levels or true-peak measurements.
HRTF channel balance and axle spectral differences do not establish human front/rear recognition.
Browser base/output latency is a device estimate. Acoustic end-to-end latency has not been measured.
A browser analyser can find invalid samples and sustained silence; it cannot prove an absence of output-device underruns.
